title: Offboarding export completeness
notes: Ticket D5 (2026-09-07): the offboarding export now covers all 42 models with a direct studentId FK to Student, so this is a gate — a future model that gains a studentId FK and is neither exported nor exempted fails the PR that adds it, rather than drifting in unremarked the way the original 30 did. generateStudentArchive() (src/lib/student-archive.ts) reads 37 of the 42: the original 7 (FormSubmission, FileUpload, Certification, PortfolioItem, ResumeData, StudentWorkProfile, Connection) plus the 30 this ticket added — Conversation+Message (the Sage transcripts, ordered, verbatim — the single biggest prior gap), SageInsight, SagePanel, Goal+GoalResourceLink, CareerDiscovery, CareerCampaign, CoachingArc, VisionBoardItem, MoodEntry, ResumeVersion, CoverLetter, Application, StudentSavedJob, Wager, StudentTask, Appointment, EventRegistration, OrientationProgress, FormResponse, ConsentRecord, SpokesRecord, StudentClassEnrollment, PublicCredentialPage, NotificationPreference (consent fields only — the SMS verification-code hash and its expiry are never selected, same reasoning as the PasswordResetToken exemption below), Notification, CaseNote (every category, including 'risk' — no category is documented staff-confidential in the schema, docs/DATA_RETENTION_POLICY.md, or .claude/rules/security.md today), StudentAlert, and FailedExtraction (a capped snapshot of the student's own message, not a new class of data). The remaining 5 stay exempted in the fixture as non-personal/derivable bookkeeping or authentication artifacts (Progression, ProgressionEvent, LlmCallLog, PasswordResetToken, SecurityQuestionAnswer) — unchanged from before this ticket. De-identification is deliberately NOT applied anywhere in this export: it is the student's own record of their own words, choices, and what they were told.
